name: Search the excavation tent and read the journal

evidence.note: Search the camp for secateurs and read the excavation journal.

name: Translate the first stone tablet

evidence.note: Search the stone table and inspect the carvings. Record island, water, time, vessel and north.

name: Cut the vines and translate the Molch tablet

evidence.note: Inspect and cut the vines, inspect the carvings, then record west, poison, body, food and earth.

name: Translate the Xeric's Shrine tablet

evidence.note: Inspect the carvings and record make, yes, no, move, arrive, east and south.

name: Translate the Morra ruins tablet

evidence.note: Inspect the last garden's carvings, then record few, big, sun, moon, life, death, mind, home, air and fire.

name: Read the warning note and final tablet

evidence.note: Search the final table for its warning note and tablet, then read both. Awards 10,000 Farming XP.

name: Ask Gordon about the missing animals

evidence.note: Gordon asks you to investigate with Mary.

name: Ask Mary where the beast went

evidence.note: Mary explains the trail. Take the pot of flour in the farmhouse.

name: Dust the gate with flour and inspect the tracks

evidence.note: Use flour on the farm gate and follow the prints towards the mine.

name: Defeat the Headless Beast

evidence.note: Defeat the level 82 beast in the mine and return with the news.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Headless Beast.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Tell Gordon why there is no head to bring back

evidence.note: Talk to Gordon and then seek Mary's advice.

name: Sculpt a substitute head from soft clay

evidence.note: Use the knife on soft clay, and get Gordon's feedback before decorating the head.

name: Stitch fur onto the clay head

evidence.note: Use a needle and thread to attach bear fur and show Gordon.

name: Colour the fur-covered head

evidence.note: Use the farmhouse red dye and show Gordon the result on the way to mounting it.

name: Mount the replica head in the farmhouse

evidence.note: Use the planks and nails with a hammer and saw.

name: Collect Gordon's reward

evidence.note: Awards 4,000 Crafting XP, 3,200 Construction XP and 3,000 GP, and unlocks the tannery.

name: Buy getting ahead fur

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Gather the farm's tools, thread and dye

evidence.note: Collect the knife and dye inside, needle and thread upstairs, and saw, hammer and nails in the farm yard.

name: Collect the mine's planks and prepare soft clay

evidence.note: Collect two planks. Use the pickaxe, clay rocks and water with the farm supplies to prepare one soft clay. The time includes returning to the mine entrance.

name: Get the official Barcrawl card

evidence.note: The guard issues the card for the ten drinks.

name: Order Uncle Humphrey's Gutrot

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Olde Suspiciouse

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Hand of Death cocktail

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Black Skull Ale

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Ape Bite Liqueur

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Old Supergrog

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Heart Stopper

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked. Check Hitpoints before drinking.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Survive the Heart Stopper and get the card stamped.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Restore Hitpoints before ordering the drink.

name: Order Liverbane

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Fire Toad Blast

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Order Fire Brandy

evidence.note: Pay the bartender for the drink and get the card marked.

name: Show the guard the finished Barcrawl card

evidence.note: Opens the Barbarian Outpost and makes the vial-smashing dialogue available. The ten drinks total 208 GP before fares.

name: Ask Thormac about his missing scorpions

evidence.note: Thormac issues a cage and refers you to a seer. The Outpost access gate applies at the third scorpion.

name: Ask a seer where to find the scorpions

evidence.note: Ask about the hidden room in Taverley Dungeon.

name: Find and catch the Taverley scorpion

evidence.note: Search the false wall near the poison spiders and use the cage inside.

name: Catch the monastery scorpion

evidence.note: Use the cage on the scorpion upstairs.

name: Catch the Barbarian Outpost scorpion

evidence.note: Use the cage on the third scorpion.

name: Return all three scorpions to Thormac

evidence.note: Awards 6,625 Strength XP and unlocks Thormac's mystic staff service.

name: Defeat the jailer and take the cell key

evidence.note: Defeat the jailer in the Black Knights' section to get his key.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the jailer and collect his key.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Free Velrak and ask about the dungeon

evidence.note: Unlock Velrak's cell and ask about the deeper dungeon to get a dusty key.

name: Buy spirits of the elid supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Ask Awusah why Nardah has no water

evidence.note: Ask the mayor about Nardah's drought.

name: Ask Ghaslor for the Ballad of Jareesh

evidence.note: Read the ballad to learn where the Elid's source is.

name: Telegrab the ancestral key from the shrine

evidence.note: Cast Telekinetic Grab with the standard spellbook from a tile where the key is visible.

name: Search the shrine cupboard and repair the robes

evidence.note: Take both torn pieces from the cupboard and stitch them with a needle and two thread.

name: Attach a rope at the headwaters and descend

evidence.note: Use a rope on the root and descend into the cave.

name: Wear the robes and open the ancestral door

evidence.note: Equip both repaired robe pieces and use the key.

name: Defeat the white golem and clear its channel

evidence.note: Use a stab weapon, then disarm the trap blocking the channel.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the white golem and clear the trap.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat the grey golem and mine its blockage

evidence.note: Use a slash weapon, then mine the rocks blocking the channel.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the grey golem and mine the blockage.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat the black golem and shoot the target

evidence.note: Use a crush weapon, then shoot the channel's target with a bow.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the black golem and hit the target.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Speak to the water spirits beyond the channels

evidence.note: Learn why the village must return the statue.

name: Speak to Awusah and cut the soles from his shoes

evidence.note: Take the shoes and cut off the soles for the genie.

name: Exchange the soles for the statuette

evidence.note: Talk to the genie and trade the soles.

name: Return the statuette to its plinth

evidence.note: Awards 2 quest points, 8,000 Prayer XP, 1,000 Thieving XP and 1,000 Magic XP.

name: Lower a rope into the Nardah crevice

evidence.note: Use a rope and carry a lit light source to descend.

name: Ask Ali Morrisane about his nephew

evidence.note: Requires 30 Thieving. Morrisane sends you to Pollnivneach.

name: Buy a headpiece and beard and make the disguise

evidence.note: Buy the pieces from Morrisane and combine them.

name: Buy three beers and question Drunken Ali

evidence.note: Buy beer from Ali the Barman and give the beers one at a time.

name: Ask the Menaphites about the dispute

evidence.note: Ask the thug about a return of the camel.

name: Ask the bandits about the dispute

evidence.note: Ask the bandit what would settle the dispute.

name: Buy two camels and collect the receipts

evidence.note: Offer Ali the Camel Man 500 GP.

name: Offer the Menaphites a camel receipt

evidence.note: Give the thug one of the receipts.

name: Offer the bandits a camel receipt

evidence.note: Give the bandit the other receipt.

name: Ask Ali the Operator to join the Menaphites

evidence.note: Accept the first job.

name: Pickpocket three villagers using the three methods

evidence.note: Pickpocket once normally, pay the urchin to distract the second, and learn to blackjack the third from Ali the Operator. The time includes the return conversations.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Complete the three successful pickpockets.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Retry the pickpockets and follow Ali the Operator's advice.

name: Steal the mayor's wife's jewels

evidence.note: Get the key from Ali the Operator, check the villa from the cactus and open the upstairs safe. Wear the disguise and gloves.

name: Return the jewels and identify the traitor

evidence.note: Deliver the jewels, ask the Menaphite thug, then report the traitor to the Operator.

name: Get a snake charm and basket from the charmer

evidence.note: Put coins into the money pot. Reserve two coins for the basket and charm.

name: Charm a snake west of the tent

evidence.note: Use the charm and catch the snake in the basket.

name: Collect dung from the camel trough

evidence.note: Get a bucket and sauce nearby, feed the camel and collect dung. The duration includes the short animation.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Collect the camel dung requested by the hag.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Try the trough again if the first dung is unsuitable.

name: Have Ali the Hag prepare the poison

evidence.note: Give the hag the snake and dung.

name: Identify the traitor's drink and add the poison

evidence.note: Ask the bartender about the traitor and use the poison on the drink.

name: Confront and defeat the Menaphite Leader

evidence.note: Report to Ali the Operator and defeat the level 75 Menaphite. Take the willow blackjack drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Menaphite and collect the willow blackjack.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat the Bandit Champion and take the scimitar

evidence.note: Ask a villager about the gangs and confront the Bandit Leader. Defeat the summoned champion while carrying the willow blackjack to collect the scimitar.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Bandit Champion and collect his adamant scimitar.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Ask Ali the Mayor about the missing nephew

evidence.note: The mayor provides the final information.

name: Report back to Ali Morrisane

evidence.note: Receive 1 quest point, 15,000 Thieving XP and 500 GP. Completion opens Rogue Trader.

name: Buy tourist trap desert clothes

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Buy tourist trap dart supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Ask Irena about her missing daughter

evidence.note: Irena asks you to find Ana in the mining camp.

name: Defeat the Mercenary Captain

evidence.note: Challenge the captain by asking about a fight with his guards. Take the metal key.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the captain and collect his metal key.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Trade desert clothing with the slave

evidence.note: Enter with weapons and armour unequipped. Swap the three desert clothing pieces for the slave outfit.

name: Ask the guard about going deeper into the mine

evidence.note: Wear the slave clothes. The guard wants a Tenti pineapple.

name: Ask Al Shabim for the pineapple

evidence.note: Agree to steal the plans from Siad and take the chest key.

name: Distract Captain Siad and take the plans

evidence.note: Search the books and distract Siad with talk of sailing. Use the key on the chest.

name: Show the technical plans to Al Shabim

evidence.note: Get permission to use the experimental anvil in the north tent.

name: Smith and fletch the prototype dart

evidence.note: Use the anvil to make the tip, then add the feathers. Budget three bars and 50 feathers for the success path. The route charges the full reserve as a conservative estimate of materials used.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Successfully make the prototype dart.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring spare bars and feathers if extra attempts are needed.

name: Exchange the prototype for the pineapple

evidence.note: Al Shabim teaches dart smithing and gives you the pineapple and six bronze darts.

name: Give the guard the pineapple

evidence.note: Wear slave clothes and bribe the guard to access the lower mine.

name: Find a barrel near the mine cart

evidence.note: Search the empty barrels near the cart.

name: Talk to Ana and hide her in the barrel

evidence.note: Keep the escape plan secret and hide Ana in the empty barrel.

name: Return by cart and load Ana on the winch

evidence.note: Send the barrel on the cart, take the cart yourself, retrieve the barrel and use the winch bucket.

name: Operate the surface winch and retrieve Ana

evidence.note: Collect Ana from the barrel west of the winch.

name: Load Ana on the cart and persuade the driver

evidence.note: Use the barrel on the cart, persuade the driver and search the cart to escape the camp.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The cart driver takes you and Ana outside the camp.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Follow the successful dialogue sequence and recover Ana if she is returned to the mines.

name: Return Ana to Irena and collect the reward

evidence.note: Irena gives two immediate 4,650 XP choices, 2 quest points and the wrought iron key.

name: Buy slug menace supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Accept the Witchaven assignment from Sir Tiffy

evidence.note: Complete Wanted! and Sea Slug and meet the four level 30 requirements. Sir Tiffy issues or upgrades the Commorb.

name: Meet Col. O'Niall on the pier

evidence.note: Ask about the villagers and the three people of interest.

name: Interview Mayor Hobb

evidence.note: Ask about the village.

name: Interview Brother Maledict

evidence.note: Ask about the villagers.

name: Speak to Holgart by the boat

evidence.note: Ask about the fishing platform.

name: Report the three interviews to O'Niall

evidence.note: O'Niall sends you to investigate the ruins.

name: Scan the imposing door and collect the dead slug

evidence.note: Follow Savant's instructions at the door and take the dead sea slug.

name: Ask Jorral to interpret the transcript

evidence.note: Speak with Jorral and Savant to learn the history of Mother Mallum.

name: Report Jorral's findings to O'Niall

evidence.note: Return to Witchaven and ask O'Niall what to do next.

name: Ask Maledict about the missing pages

evidence.note: Watch the scene and ask the priest how to renew the seal.

name: Search the mayor's desk for the first page

evidence.note: Take the first page from the desk.

name: Ask Lovecraft for the second page

evidence.note: Get the second page from the shopkeeper.

name: Collect the third-page fragments

evidence.note: O'Niall hands over the three fragments.

name: Consult Savant about the torn page

evidence.note: Attempt to use swamp paste. Savant stops you and suggests the dead slug.

name: Ask Bailey for sea slug glue

evidence.note: Give Bailey the dead slug on the Fishing Platform.

name: Assemble the third page and read the instructions

evidence.note: Use Bailey's glue to assemble the fragments, then read all the pages.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Slug Prince with melee.
